560-2034-5220-6277-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
560-2034-5220-6277-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

678-4022-8095.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-4022-8095.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat.

1542-1624-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2528-5088-6798-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2528-5088-6798-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

997-5058-7422.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6822-7256.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3490-4050-6822-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Warhost's Frenzy triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

3713-5078-5268-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

955-2366-3322-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
955-2366-3322-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-3678-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3678-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

292-1495-7061.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-7061.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

3234-3293-5413-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5413-6797.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5413-6797.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4068-6188-6911.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one Mountain.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4068-6188-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

224-1257-5621.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

552-2196-2821-5803.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
552-2196-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five basic Swamps.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
552-2196-2821-5803.description:
Activate Cabal Stronghold by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate another land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Cabal Stronghold and another land.
Activate Cabal Stronghold by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate another land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 5.

2557-5636-5742-5743.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1247-2107-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-2107-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Sunastian Falconer's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2608-5168-5542-5686.manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control a black or red permanent
2608-5168-5542-5686.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}{B}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Derevi.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
2608-5168-5542-5686.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent(s) using Derevi.

731-5610.easyPrerequisites: Corrupted Conscience attached to Hydra Omnivore.
731-5610.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Hydra Omnivore.
You have a way to increase Hydra Omnivore's power by 2 or more, or each opponent has at least two poison counters.
731-5610.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Hydra Omnivore, causing them to get at least eight poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Hydra Omnivore triggers, causing each other opponent to get at least eight poison counters.
Each remaining opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

2511-2724-3217-3582.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

144-1636-4319-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield face down.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Ashcloud Phoenix's power.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Ashcloud Phoenix face up.
Repeat.

856-4231-5256-5267.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' first ability triggers, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cauldron Familiar's power.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
